businessReports.description: Separate Fragmento and ASC activity quantities for monthly client reporting and Excel export.
businessReports.fragmentoDescription: Orders, sales totals, kitchen additions and recorded emails.
businessReports.ascDescription: Claims and kitchen additions from FRG and ARC, reported separately.
businessReports.ascEmailCoverage: Only recorded claim emails sent to the two listed addresses are counted. Other recipients and local test redirections are excluded.
businessReports.filterNote: Fragmento and ASC use the date range and contract type. Type and status filter the detailed list below. All dates use Europe/Berlin; weeks start on Monday.
businessReports.quantityNote: Activity quantities and Fragmento order sales. Apply your agreed service costs separately. Excel includes separate Fragmento and ASC sheets.
businessReports.definitionsSummary: Kitchen sources, email coverage and counting dates
businessReports.emailCoverage: Email counts cover recorded successful deliveries. Historical emails without delivery logs are not included.
businessReports.note1: Periods use Europe/Berlin. Weeks start on Monday. Test contracts starting with 111 are excluded.
businessReports.note2: Business tables use the date range and contract type; the type/status filters apply only to the order/claim detail table.
businessReports.note3: Kitchen models are counted once per source (FRG or ARC), when the first live contract is added. Contracts count individual kitchen assignments. A model shared by FRG and ARC appears once in each source.
businessReports.note4: ASC kitchen additions use contract creation dates: FRG contracts are available in ASC through the shared kitchen database. A separate historical transfer date is not recorded.
businessReports.note5: Orders and claims use creation dates. Cancellation requests use their received date and include all statuses (received, approved and rejected), including requests not yet matched to an order. Only periods with activity are listed.
businessReports.note6: Emails count successful recipient deliveries on the logged send date, including successful resends. Fragmento includes order and cancellation emails. ASC counts recorded claim emails to kd@myarchitecto.de and verwaltung@hbi-wohnen.de separately; other recipients, feedback invitations and redirected local test emails are excluded. Failed, skipped, unknown and historical unlogged deliveries are not included.
businessReports.note7: Fragmento sales use the stored gross prices of the same orders included in the order count, across all statuses. Net sales are calculated per order using 19% VAT and rounded to cents before summing. Service costs are applied separately.

frgMonthlyReport.title: Fragmento — report
frgMonthlyReport.countingNote: Each FRG kitchen counts once by its creation date, regardless of contract prefixes. Sales include currently confirmed orders only. Kitchens with only test contracts starting with 111 are excluded.
frgMonthlyReport.emailNote: Emails count recorded successful recipient deliveries, including resends. Cancellation requests count received requests across all statuses.
frgMonthlyReport.historicalNote: {count} historical sales have no recorded confirmation date and use their creation date. These are marked in Excel. Historical months reflect current order statuses.
frgMonthlyReport.exportNote: Excel includes this summary, individual orders, ordered items with manufacturers, and report definitions.
